reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is hard-clipped by the viewport edge — the title is cut mid-word with no ellipsis and the card has no trailing gutter, so it reads as broken rather than as an intentional peek.
The pizza card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which implies a fully free item and looks like a data/formatting error (likely meant to be a smaller percentage or a '100% off delivery' label).

The two favorite (heart) buttons in 'Popular right now' use different treatments — the first is a white/light circle, the second a dark translucent circle — creating inconsistent visual language between identical controls.
Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as an image overlay badge and again in the metadata row below the title.
Thumbnail treatments are inconsistent: the 'Green Bowl Poké' image has a light grey background while the neighbouring cards use dark, vignetted photography, making the row look unbalanced.
The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible and no fade or padding, which reads as clipped content rather than a scrollable list.
Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart/favorite buttons) have no visible text label, so their purpose and state rely solely on iconography.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 1 describes the pizza card's −100% discount badge and the same formatting problem.
